summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; client_id/client_secret from login/password with extra fallbacks; auth_type oauth; both secrets as env-var references). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and inserted it in profile_mappings directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection from extras, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, per instructions; the changes were verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
